name: Bocketts Farm Park, Fetcham
summary: Bocketts is a working family farm attraction with animals, indoor and outdoor play and a changing programme that can include tractor rides, pony rides and pig racing. Its mix of covered and open-air activities makes it useful in uncertain weather.
reasonToVisit: A working farm with animals, play areas and a changing seasonal programme
planningDetail: Mix of covered and open-air activities — useful in uncertain weather
